map.归一化去空格 / 连字符 / 括号 / 点；带 + 时按国家码库 3→1 位前缀: Normalize by stripping spaces / hyphens / parentheses / dots. With a leading +, match the country-code database by trying 3→1 digit prefixes. Without +: a match for ^1[3-9]\d{9}$ indicates a Chinese mainland mobile number (map the first 3 digits to the carrier); a match for ^0\d{10,11}$ indicates a landline (010 / 02x use a 2-digit area code, others match the 3–4 digit area-code table, and the first digit of the number is never folded into the area code).
map.按 ITU 国家代码库 + 中国号段表推断国家/区号/运营商；只做格式识别与归一: Infers country, area code and carrier from an ITU country-code table and a China number-prefix table. It only recognizes and normalizes formats; it does not verify that a number actually exists.
map.页面先归一化：去掉空格、连字符、括号与点号；以「+」开头时按 3→1 位贪心匹配: The page normalizes first: spaces, hyphens, brackets and dots are removed. When the input starts with +, country codes are matched greedily from 3 digits down to 1.
map.库（如 +86 中国、+1 美国/加拿大），匹配后再对中国号码做区号与运营商推断: table (e.g. +86 China, +1 US/Canada); after matching, Chinese numbers are checked for area code and carrier. Chinese mobile numbers follow the ^1[3-9] plus 9 digits pattern, and the carrier is taken from the first 3 digits (170/171 and similar are virtual operators). Landlines are handled as 0 + area code; for 010 and 02x the area code body is 2 digits, others are matched against a built-in 3-4 digit prefix table, and unknown prefixes fall back to Unknown city.

map.+86 13800138000 → 国家代码 +86 - 中国；国内号码 138: +86 13800138000 → country code +86 - China; domestic number 13800138000; likely carrier China Mobile (138 prefix); normalized +8613800138000, 13 digits. +1 212-555-0100 → country code +1 - US/Canada; domestic number 2125550100; normalized +12125550100, 11 digits. 010-12345678 → no country code given, treated as local; inferred China (landline), area code 010 - Beijing; normalized 01012345678, 11 digits. 12345abc → reports "Only digits, +, spaces and hyphens are allowed" and stops parsing.
map.中国大陆手机号为 11 位、以 1 开头；固话为「0 + 2–4 位区号 + 7: Mainland China mobile numbers have 11 digits and start with 1; landlines follow 0 + 2-4 digit area code + 7-8 digit subscriber number, so total length varies (010 has a 10-digit body plus the leading 0, 11 digits in all; some cities with 4-digit area codes reach 12 digits). International numbers vary even more (the US uses a 10-digit domestic number plus a 1-digit country code), so digit count is only a formatting hint and cannot determine the country on its own.
map.把号段当归属地：号段只反映注册运营商与大致区域，携号转网后运营商可能已变，虚拟号: Treating a prefix as a location: a prefix only reflects the registering carrier and rough region; after number portability the carrier may have changed, and virtual prefixes (170/171) give even less reliable location data. Keeping the trunk 0 after +86: the page adds 0 before detecting the area code, but writing +86 010... yourself can leave an extra 0 after normalization, so omit the trunk prefix in international format. Treating a valid format as a real number: this page never checks whether a number exists, it only recognizes structure.
map.+81 3-1234-5678 → 国家代码 +81 - 日本；国内号码 312: +81 3-1234-5678 → country code +81 - Japan; domestic number 312345678; normalized +81312345678; 11 digits. +852 91234567 → reports "Unrecognized country code": the code table only covers common countries and regions, so codes not listed such as +852 (Hong Kong, China) need manual judgement and the page will not guess. If the same number is written as 0081 3-1234-5678 without the +, the page treats it as a local number and will not detect the international prefix automatically - keep the + for international format.
map.+49 30 123456 → 国家代码 +49 - 德国；国内号码 30123: +49 30 123456 → country code +49 - Germany; domestic number 30123456; normalized +4930123456; 10 digits. +44 20 7946 0958 → country code +44 - UK; domestic number 2079460958; normalized +442079460958; 12 digits - both are country code + domestic number, yet the length differs from the German example.
map.位数统计包含国家代码：86（2 位）+ 手机号 11 位 = 13 位；国内号码: The digit count includes the country code: 86 (2 digits) + 11-digit mobile number = 13 digits; the domestic number itself is still 11 digits.
map.区号 010 为什么按 2 位切？: Why is area code 010 split after 2 digits?
map.010 的长途前缀 0 之后只有 10 两位，若按 3 位切会把号码首位并进区号: After the trunk prefix 0 in 010, only the two digits 10 remain; splitting after 3 digits would pull the first digit of the subscriber number into the area code (giving 0101-Unknown city). The page therefore handles 010 and 02x separately with a 2-digit split.
